LESSON: READING THREE TO FOUR LETTER WORDS

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.8: Reading three to four letter words

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading three to four letter words. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we blend syllables (3 HRS) form three to four letter to make words?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out • Learners could be of class. involved in a variety of activities to read three to
2. Enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: READING THREE TO FOUR LETTER WORDS
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Reading three to four letter words helps you succeed in LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: READING THREE TO FOUR LETTER WORDS
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out • Learners could be of class. involved in a variety of activities to read three to

What this means
In this part you learn to Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out • Learners could be of class. involved in a variety of activities to read three to. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out • Learners could be of class. involved in a variety of activities to read three to.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Reading three to four letter words”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out • Learners could be of class. involved in a variety of activities to read three to. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class

What this means
In this part you learn to Enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Reading three to four letter words to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Reading three to four letter words is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Reading three to four letter words”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out • Learners could be of class. involved in a variety of activities to read three to)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Reading three to four letter words to a partner. (skill: Enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Reading three to four letter words to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out • Learners could be of class. involved in a variety of activities to read three to.
3. Practise this skill: Enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Reading three to four letter words from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Reading three to four letter words: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP2 learner study Reading three to four letter words?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we blend syllables (3 HRS) form three to four letter to make words?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Reading three to four letter words means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out • Learners could be of class. involved in a variety of activities to read three to.
5. Be able to: Enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class.
